title: Corporate Catalyst Pipeline Input
description: Pulls material 8-K events for your tickers, attaches insider open-market buying in a window around each event, scores conviction 0 to 100, and tiers each catalyst.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Stock tickers to track, e.g. ["NVDA", "TSLA", "PLTR"]. Provide tickers or CIKs.

ciks.title: CIKs (optional)
ciks.description: SEC CIK numbers, an alternative to tickers.

maxAgeHours.title: Max age (hours)
maxAgeHours.description: Ignore 8-K filings older than this. 720 = 30 days.

insiderWindowDays.title: Insider window (days)
insiderWindowDays.description: Count insider buys and sells within this many days on either side of the 8-K event date.

materialOnly.title: Material events only
materialOnly.description: Drop 8-K filings that carry only routine items (such as exhibits or routine votes) and keep the ones that move stocks.

includeInsider.title: Include insider buying
includeInsider.description: Attach insider open-market buys and sells around each event. Turn off for events only.

maxEventsTotal.title: Max events to score
maxEventsTotal.description: Cap on events scored, most recent first.

minScore.title: Minimum conviction score
minScore.description: Drop and never charge events scoring below this 0 to 100 threshold. 0 keeps every material event.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. EDGAR does not need a proxy, so the default is no proxy.
